description: Search Trip.com hotels for a city and stay dates, or fetch full details and nightly prices for specific hotel IDs.

breakfastIncluded.description: Only return rooms whose rate includes breakfast.
breakfastIncluded.title: Breakfast Included Only

checkOut.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Leave blank for the night after check-in.
checkOut.title: Check-out Date

cityId.description: Exact Trip.com geo code, if you already know it (London = 338). Overrides the city name.
cityId.title: Trip.com City ID (optional)

cityName.description: City to search, e.g. London, Paris, Tokyo, Bangkok, Dubai. Country names also work: 'Paris, France'.
cityName.title: City

freeCancellation.description: Only return rooms with a free-cancellation policy.
freeCancellation.title: Free Cancellation Only

hotelId.description: One Trip.com hotel ID or detail URL, e.g. 731904. Used when mode is 'Hotel details by ID'.
hotelId.title: Hotel ID or URL (detail mode)

hotelIds.description: Multiple Trip.com hotel IDs or detail URLs. Combined with 'hotelId' when both are provided.
hotelIds.title: Hotel IDs or URLs (batch detail mode)

includeDetails.description: Fetch each hotel's detail page for its full address, facilities, description, phone and check-in times. Adds one request per hotel.
includeDetails.title: Enrich Search Results with Hotel Details

maxPrice.description: Highest nightly room price in the selected currency, before taxes.
maxPrice.title: Maximum Nightly Price

maxStars.description: Highest official star class to include (1-5).
maxStars.title: Maximum Star Rating

minRating.description: Trip.com guest score on a 0-10 scale, e.g. 8 for 'Very good'.
minRating.title: Minimum Guest Score

minStars.description: Lowest official star class to include (1-5).
minStars.title: Minimum Star Rating

mode.description: Choose 'Search hotels' to browse a city, or 'Hotel details by ID' to fetch specific properties.
enumTitles: Search hotels by city and dates
Hotel details by ID or URL
mode.title: Mode

payAtHotel.description: Only return rooms that can be paid for at the property.
payAtHotel.title: Pay at Hotel Only

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Leave unchanged for a direct connection; the actor uses Apify Proxy automatically if Trip.com blocks the datacenter IP.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

sortBy.description: Order of the returned hotels. Price and rating sorts scan extra result slices before trimming.
sortBy.title: Sort Results By

title: Trip.com Hotels Scraper Input
